1. This permission may be cited as “Permission to disburse under third supplementary ﬁ nancial statement - 2023 of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Counicl” and come in to operation from 31.12.2023.

2. The expenditure of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which is estimated for the service of the period beginning on 01st January, 2023 and ending 31st December 2023, which is speciﬁ ed as “ﬁ nancial year 2023” in the Annual Financial Statement and Revenue – Expenditure Estimates prepared for the year 2023, that was approved on 30.11.2022 and amended by ﬁ rst and second supplementary ﬁ nancial statements for the year 2023, Rupees Fifty One Billion Three Hundred and One Million Eight Hundred and Nine Thousand One Hundred and Fifty Seven and cents Thirteen Only (Rs. 51,301,809,157.13) and grant permission to the Chief Secretary of this Province and other Accounting Oﬃ cers to disburse the same from the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund.

I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Oﬃ cers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to disburse as per the third Supplementary Financial statement for the year 2023 , by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 27 (a) of the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017.

The expenditure of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which is estimated Rupees Fifty One Billion Three Hundred and One Million Eight Hundred and Nine Thousand One Hundred and Fifty Seven and cents Thirteen Only (Rs. 51,301,809,157.13) for the services of the period beginning on 01st January, 2023 and ending 31st December, 2023, which is speciﬁ ed in the Annual Financial Statement and Revenue – Expenditure Estimates for the year 2023 and grant permission to disburse the same from the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund.

This permission will be valid till 31st of December, 2023 or up to the date that expires three months (03) from the date of summoning the Seventh (07th) Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs ﬁ rst.
Nൺඏංඇ Dංඌඌൺඇൺඒൺ඄ൾ Hon. Governor, Sabaragamuwa Province 31st day of December, 2023

I do hereby approve to amend the advance account limits stated in the ﬁ fth Schedule of the Third Supplementary Financial Statement for the year 2023, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 27 (a) of the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017.
Accordingly, I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Oﬃ cers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to bear the expenses subject to those limits.

This permission will be valid till 31st of December, 2023 or upto the date that expires three months (03) from the date of summoning the Seventh (07th) Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs ﬁ rst.
